title: MV The Silent Kingdom - Dark Otome RPG (demo)

posts.author: LuckyCatOtome
posts.body:
Hello, everyone! Long time lurker here, being able to finally show the project I've been working on for almost a year. 'The Silent Kingdom' is a story-driven, otome RPG where player's choices and interactions with other characters set the narrative.
So far I have the full demo released on both Steam and Itch.io for free, and a Kickstarter campaign is currently running. Please give the demo a try if you have the time! ^^
Spoiler:
Synopsis & features
This is the dark tale of a princess who must corrupt her own soul in order to save her kingdom, reaping death and sorrow along the path.
The game features:
A main character that's defined, yet mouldable to your taste.
As the player, you’ll be free to choose the way the protagonist speaks to and perceives others, decide on her thoughts and emotions regarding various different events, and even select your own preferred name for her if you so wish. Every decision that falls into her hands - large or small - ultimately falls into yours.
Roleplay experience.
Apart from the most impactful decisions in the story, many dialogue interactions will also contain choices that merely focus on immersion, allowing the player to establish exactly the kind of personality and emotions that they wish to give their princess. There is never any “correct” answer when it comes to interacting with others, just different answers.
Romance.
The princess will have the ability to develop bonds and even romantic relationships with either of the two companion characters she’ll travel with. Although not required in order to see the story to its completion, the relationships you forge with other characters will play a pivotal role in its development.
Dark and emotional story.
In this world where every conflict and resolution are bathed in various shades of grey, tragedies and souls stained by corruption arise one after another. Will the princess question her own morality? Will narcissism and lust for power replace faithful bonds to become her most loyal companions? And from what prism will she judge the sins of others?
Anime style CGs.
As the story unfolds, many of its scenes will contain original illustrations.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Wow, this was some next level stuff
A title music with vocals, nice! This has the best presentation of any of the games I've seen here. The mapping is obviously great and I really like how the small animations make the character "busts" more lively during the dialogues. The writing seems done by someone with a good grasp of English language. Also really liked some of the 2D art. And nice job with the terrors! Some suggestions/thoughts below:
-The princess walking looks a bit funny, maybe she could swing her arms less or something?
-And also when Seneca joined for a brief while in the woods as a party member, it looked a bit funny when their arms swung in perfect synchrony - looked a bit like a marching band or something, maybe make their arms swing a little less in sync?
-The castle music track stops somehow abruptly I think - maybe there could be some kind of smoother transition to the repeat?
-I noticed some small clipping in the castle or whatever you call it in English - like the character sprite appeared a bit on top the side of the chest in the castle and I think there was some other object also
-Not having a different animation when going up ladders looked a bit funny
-When I had to find a weapon, maybe you could hint about checking that one room - I ran around for quite some time (thought I had to get a knife from the kitchen or something) before realizing there was a weapon rack in the storage room
-When the princess is presented what she must do with the dagger, maybe there could be some more reaction/inner monologue before you pick her reaction from the choices
-The only battle skill the princess had felt kind of meh
-I would use some kind of plugin to remove the asking of fight/escape in the beginning of every turn
Yep, I think that's most of the small comments I had in mind. A really great game, and I could definitely play the full version.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
I gave this another go thanks to the feedback festival event, since I remember I was impressed by the demo 3 years ago and I heard this had a successful Kickstarter and that the demo has been updated.
Like I said earlier, the graphical presentation is really impressive, the overall quality is maybe the best that I've seen in RPGMaker games. I like everything from the mapping to the sprites and the CGs are really impressive. There's a couple of small points I'll comment. The braziers in the castle entrance hallway look to me like they could use some edits to make them fit better with the tileset. And I'm not the biggest fan of the "backside" limbs of the princess walking sprite appearing completely black when walking sideways.
The music is good and builds atmosphere nicely, but I think the dashing clop clop SE cycles too fast though, and I'm not the biggest fan of the cling menu/cursor select SE.
I think the story is interesting and the dialogue is a lot better than your average RPG Maker game.
The battles had some challenge (at least against the multiple guards) which was nice and you added some skills from the time of the original demo. However, there's a huge framedrop (at least for me) when the battle transition starts from the map and also I was suffering from frame drops when fighting the multiple enemies (guards) at once. Also the blood effect seems to play even if an attack misses. I'd put a conditional branch in the action sequence to check if it hit or missed (same with the block mechanic). I'd also make a change to the single/multi-selection. I think it's better if you'd have to press a button to shift to the multi-select or at least make it so that if there's only one enemy remaining, then it wouldn't ask about the selection.
Some random comments:
-with the level of presentation of the game, I'd still take the extra step of making a climbing sprite when going up the ladder
-kid Chrono sprite doesn't turn toward you when you talk to him in the training yard
-the Rex Impera skill causes a blood effect in the training match (when your other attacks don't)
-I was playing the STEAM demo and when I quit the game from the title screen, the game freezes and doesn't close.
-When I offered the silver coins to the statue, nothing happened (perhaps there could be an explanation...)
-Old silver coin description says "Perhaps it has any collector's value."
-Maid who brings message from librarian "I applaud you not..." (shouldn't there be a 'for'?)
-Near the end the Oracles says "I know you don't have bad heart princess"

posts.author: LuckyCatOtome
posts.body:
Aaah, thank you very, very much for all the feedback!! You gave me very useful points. I'd like to address them:
-First of all, and unfortunately, there are things that I can't change because I don't know coding. For example, what you mention about single/multi-selection. That feature is done by a plugin and I wouldn't know how to change it on my own. However, about that matter in particular I must say that it worked for me, since single and multi targets require different amounts of MP, so the single-multi menu helps you see how much MP is required for each. You won't always have enough MP for area attacks.
-Ohh, so the blood effect plays if an attack misses? I actually did use a conditional branch to prevent that (which was quite a feat for my non existent coding skills hahaha). I could swear it worked when I tested it back in the day. But maybe I messed the code in any skill. I'll look into it, thank you for pointing it out!
-It actually makes me very happy that you noticed that the training attacks don't draw blood! I figured out how to change the default attack for each weapon, so I made sure that the training one would be friendly hahaha. However, other skills couldn't be changed. I considered creating an alt version of Rex Impera just for the training, and then make the princess unlearn it and learn the blood version. But in the end I thought that would be too troublesome for something so small. I might change it in the end though, since you've noticed ^^
-The dashing step sounds have been changed to be less fast, though I haven't updated the demo with this change yet.
-About ladder climbing sprite... My problem was how it'd work when your body is half-way out the ladder but not quite out yet. I had the feeling it could look a bit odd. However, I'll add this to the list of nice details I could try to add if I find some extra time. (I'm working on the game non stop).
-Chrono didn't leave his training position when talked to. I programmed it so that he'd simply stop his animation. However, after your feedback, I've gone ahead and changed it. Now he'll stand normally and look at the player when talked to, and return to the training position when dialogue ends ^^
-The freezing that happens when quitting the game seems related to the plugin that adds the quit option. I've noticed it too, but I don't know how to solve it since it's related to coding
-If you offer the wrong number of coins to the statue, there should be a message saying that your offering has no effect. (The correct number is the one that Argus mentions when he gives you the coins.) I made it so that you have only one attempt, otherwise, it'd be very easy hahaha.
-Aaaaah! I hadn't noticed those typos! Thank you!! I've just corrected them. The changes will appear in the next update. Good catch!
I hope I didn't forget anything. Thank you again for all the feedback ^^
You've played the demo twice. I appreciate it.

posts.author: Slaughty
posts.body:
Howdy, I played your game for the forum’s Feedback Festival and made a Let’s Play video!
Spoiler:
Feedback
I really really enjoyed your demo! I played the entire thing from start to finish. The art is fantastic and just a sight to behold. Mapping is really well done and I didn’t run into any collision errors or anything that felt out of place. I really like the use of “shinies” on interactables so I don’t have to go around pressing the action button on every tile. I really don’t have anything negative to say and it’s no wonder your game came highly recommended from Moz.
Anytime I was saying to myself, why is that? Or what is this? It was answered in like the next dialogue. There was sometimes some dialogue that felt verbose but in reality, it’s how I would imagine royals would speak. There’s a few times it seems like some of the servants would speak to Erinys like she doesn’t have a higher position but at the same time, she is supposed to be a “child” and it makes sense later when you discover more about what is really going on.
The music was done well, sounded great, and really fit the mood and world. Sound FX were nice and even though some are RTP, they were used tastefully. Same with the default animations. I would have preferred to see some more custom ones but that may be just because I’m so used to them. I’m sure most people wouldn’t mind and they seem to fit well.
The battlers were gorgeous and I really love the small touches like the bust sprites blinking. This is a really well done game and I wish you success with your full release. I’m going to wish list on steam and will be eagerly awaiting release.

posts.author: Starmage
posts.body:
Hello! I played the demo also for the Feedback Festival! And wow! What a gorgeous game! I love the environmental story-telling, there's so much! The lighting, effects, sound effects. They all help to make the game feel so immersive and real! The sprites and artwork are just perfect! The music fit in every scene too! The aesthetics is very inspiring to me! The battle system is fun and fast-paced, how I like 'em, and the battle sprites are just as gorgeous. Now, so much for being in awe with all the graphics/audio. xD
The story is my favorite part. The gorgeous graphics just add so much to it. But it really got me hooked and intrigued! *spoilers* I love the reveal about the princess being trapped in a dream, and it was all executed so nicely! I know some people will say, "Oh, too many cutscenes/story," but I think you did a great job making it engaging. I didn't mind that there were more cutscenes than battles. I love how elegantly the characters speak, and it fits them being royals. The Otome aspects of the game were also fun! I'd probably have Erinys romance Chrono if I could. (The real world of age Chrono of course, not the child version lol) xD
As for feedback, there aren't much I can say since I loved almost everything about it, but I would say there's a lot of backtracking in the game that pads the game a little too much. Like when you wake up in the cycle you have to walk all the way to everything again. Maybe skip the scenes to the main events once she wakes up again? (Make her immediately get to the training session and lessons with the professor after encountering Seneca), and when she woke up in the *spoilers* real world where all the people were turned to stone, she walks super slow (which of course makes sense for the story), but again backtracking when I realize I need to go down via the vines in the balcony instead of the main exit.
Also, there's a bit of inconsistency with the interactables. Sometimes there are no shiny indicators that let the player know they're interactable, and sometimes there are.
But yeah, those are just a few I can share at the top of my head that may help improve the experience. Overall, this is a masterpiece, not just visually/auditorally, but also narratively! Keep it up! Can't wait for the release! ^^
